basic_info.description: RARE OPPORTUNITY in Inner Sunset! This ground-up 2010 construction offers multiple pathways to prosperity—live in one unit while generating rental income from others or create the perfect multi-generational family compound. Built to modern codes with advanced earthquake bracing, this turnkey property delivers what vintage buildings cannot. Enjoy breathtaking views from wraparound decks, entertain in spacious living areas, and relish the luxury of a usable yard—a true gem in urban San Francisco. The prime walkable location puts you steps from UCSF Medical Center, Golden Gate Park, and the neighborhood's celebrated cafes and restaurants. The attached full garage provides convenience rarely found in city properties. Smart investors will recognize the potential: newer construction means lower maintenance costs, and better rental opportunity, while modern amenities command premium rental rates in this perennially desirable neighborhood. Whether you're seeking income property, a family compound, or proximity to world-class medical facilities, this versatile property delivers exceptional value with modern safety features and architectural excellence. Don't miss this extraordinary opportunity to secure your future in one of San Francisco's most beloved neighborhoods! Open house 05/17 1-4
